invariants.invariant: A parent hash must be resolvable (genesis | in dag | committed) before the citing vertex can enter any node's causal cone; the commit path must never encounter a hole from an admitted vertex.
invariants.violated_by: One well-formed signed vertex citing a hash that will never exist; walk_history returns None forever; no anchor commits again.
invariants.why_it_failed: Ingress trusted the citer; resolvability was only checked at commit time, where the only response was to stop.

invariants.invariant: Redelivery must be a PULL from a node that HOLDS the vertex. No mechanism may require a node to already hold data in order to obtain it.
invariants.violated_by: Dropping unresolved vertices and relying on the re-gossip loop, which pushes dag.values() only while the node is BELOW parent quorum — the holders are above quorum and never re-send.
invariants.why_it_failed: The redelivery argument was inverted: it could only move data from a node that lacked it, never from one that had it.

invariants.invariant: Every eviction/TTL key for held vertices must be a quantity the SENDER cannot inflate. vertex.round is sender-chosen up to current_round+10_000 and is inadmissible.
invariants.violated_by: 2000 vertices at round current+9_000 citing a fake parent; TTL sweep (round < current-20) never fires; buffer pinned for ~10k rounds, honest vertices dropped.
invariants.why_it_failed: Age was measured on attacker-declared data instead of the receiver's own clock/round progression.

invariants.invariant: Held-vertex capacity must be bounded in BYTES and PER-AUTHOR, not only by count.
invariants.violated_by: MAX_ORPHANS=2000 x MAX_VERTEX_BYTES=768KiB = ~1.5GiB pinned on every node (OOM on Pi) by one validator.
invariants.why_it_failed: Count bound ignored that each entry is attacker-sized; no per-author quota let one key take every slot.

invariants.invariant: Holding must be idempotent per vertex hash: the same vertex arrives via gossipsub, direct TCP, and the re-gossip loop.
invariants.violated_by: Unconditional push into the buffer parked ~2 copies/sec of the same vertex during ordinary bootstrap.
invariants.why_it_failed: The buffer counted deliveries, not distinct vertices; and the parent gate ran BEFORE the duplicate-hash check.

invariants.invariant: Any 'admitted' signal that triggers downstream release must be true iff the vertex reached dag.insert, on validator AND observer nodes alike.
invariants.violated_by: add_vertex_inner returned false at the observer guard AFTER inserting; orphans never drained on indexer/RPC/DEX/jailed nodes.
invariants.why_it_failed: One boolean answered two questions ('inserted?' and 'continue ordering?').

invariants.invariant: Releasing held vertices must be O(newly-settled hashes), keyed by the settled hash, and must not re-run full signature/hash verification per replay.
invariants.violated_by: retry_parked_vertices drained and re-verified the whole buffer once per synced block: O(blocks x orphans) Ed25519 + SHA-256 during catch-up; a restarted validator could never rejoin.
invariants.why_it_failed: Replay was blind (drain everything) instead of indexed (release what the new settlement unblocks).

invariants.invariant: A hash becoming settled via SYNC (adopt_synced_anchor -> committed_set) must release held dependents exactly as arrival via gossip does.
invariants.violated_by: Release only ran inside add_vertex; sync-settled parents never released their children.
invariants.why_it_failed: Two settlement paths, one release hook.

invariants.invariant: Equivocation must never create a citable-but-unobtainable hash. If the second vertex is dropped, peers that saw it first WILL cite it.
invariants.violated_by: Byzantine V sends A to N1,N2 and B to N3,N4; each pair cites its own; neither can obtain the other; commit wedges on both sides; the slash never lands.
invariants.why_it_failed: Narwhal's drop-second is safe only because certificates prevent citing the dropped one; AINCORE copied the drop without the certificate.

invariants.invariant: A restarted or newly-joined validator must be able to re-enter the DAG from a gap LARGER than any re-gossip window, without already holding recent vertices.
invariants.violated_by: Validator down 30-60 rounds returns; every live vertex cites parents it lacks; nothing re-requests them; it builds one stale vertex and sits below quorum forever; reload_chain_tip caps at its own starved quorum_round.
invariants.why_it_failed: Re-entry depended on the node's own (empty) recent view.

invariants.invariant: Far-future vertices must be bounded in memory and storage; MAX_ROUND_JUMP=10_000 x 768KiB is ~7GB per validator key.
invariants.violated_by: One vertex per round for 10_000 future rounds, each 768KiB of payload, all stored and replayed at boot.
invariants.why_it_failed: Round-jump cap bounded the round number, not the bytes admitted per author per window.

invariants.invariant: The gossip limiter must NEVER ban or disconnect on any identity the sender can influence. propagation_source is the relay; message.source is replayable. Drop-only.
invariants.violated_by: Keyed on relay: strangers make validators ban each other. Keyed on publisher: replaying a victim's own signed messages bans the victim. Honest recovery burst (4 rounds x n authors) trips it at n>=26.
invariants.why_it_failed: Attribution in gossipsub is not reliable enough to justify a punishment that can partition consensus.

invariants.invariant: Every remote-keyed map must be swept or bounded.
invariants.violated_by: conn_tracker / lidar_tracker keyed by attacker-minted identities with no sweep.

invariants.invariant: Any timed action (expiry, retry) must run independently of inbound traffic.
invariants.violated_by: Ban expiry lived inside the Message handler; a node that banned everyone received nothing and never un-banned.
invariants.why_it_failed: The event that should trigger recovery was the event the failure suppressed.

invariants.invariant: Inbound TCP session capacity must reserve slots for validators or evict, so unauthenticated peers cannot deny sync/fetch service.
invariants.violated_by: 100 sessions live after a 32-byte X25519 exchange, no eviction; honest validators' secure_connect fails.
invariants.why_it_failed: Capacity was first-come with no notion of who matters.

invariants.invariant: Lock order is ordering_engine -> dag (as in try_commit); add_vertex must never be re-entered while either lock is held; no path may take dag then ordering_engine.
invariants.violated_by: reload_chain_tip -> retry_parked_vertices -> add_vertex re-entered ingress during block placement.
invariants.why_it_failed: A release hook was called from inside a path that already held state.
